entry.name: rand~
entry.description: Use the rand~ object to generate a signal consisting of random values between -1 and 1 generated at a frequency specified by its input. It interpolates linearly between these values.

arguments.name: initial-frequency
arguments.description: Sets the initial frequency. The default value is 0. If a signal is connected to the inlet, the argument is ignored.
